title: Portfolio Selection by Joint Estimation-Robustness Optimization with the Return and Risk Constraints
summary: In answering the main criticism of the classical robust optimization that the size of the uncertainty set has to be determined beforehand, a recently proposed Joint Estimation and Robustness Optimization framework treats the size of the uncertainty set as a variable and maximizes it subject to some robust conditions over the uncertainty set. This paper studies its effect on portfolio selection when both the robust return and risk constraints are built into Joint Estimation and Robustness Optimization framework.
